tools.name: ads_get_ad_entities
tools.description: Get ads, ad sets, campaigns or the account with their metrics for a date range. Arguments: ad_account_id, level (account | ad), time_increment (1 = daily, 7 = weekly), since, until (YYYY-MM-DD), ad_ids (optional), fields (optional).

tools.name: ads_get_creatives
tools.description: Get an ad's creative: primary text, headline, call to action, thumbnail.

tools.name: ads_get_ad_videos
tools.description: Get an ad's video: id, length, preview and download links.
